visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male chef in a white uniform, brown apron, and black cap prepares dough on a light marble counter in a bright indoor kitchen setting. (2) Close-ups show black-gloved hands pressing and stretching pale dough, followed by a macro shot of a cheese-covered pizza slice being pulled apart with visible steam and melting cheese. (3) The chef stands behind a glass display case filled with various rectangular pizzas, gesturing with his hands while talking in a brightly lit retail environment. (4) The chef slides a pizza tray into a professional oven; subsequent shots show multiple trays of rectangular pizzas with toppings like green herbs, red sauce, and sliced red onions. (5) Macro shots display individual pizza slices: one with tomatoes and basil, one with ham and green sauce, one with orange fish topping, and one being drizzled with red chili oil from a glass bottle. (6) Sweet dessert pizzas are showcased with toppings of toasted nuts, honey, and chocolate with fresh banana slices on a crusty base. (7) A clear glass of green liquid and one of red liquid are shown against an outdoor green background, followed by a blue cup of pistachio-colored ice cream being scooped with a pink plastic spoon. (8) Shots of the restaurant interior show light wooden chairs and white tables with hanging plants, while the exterior features a green artificial turf area with round tables and chairs. (9) The chef holds a large wooden board featuring an assortment of pizza slices outdoors on a sunny day; the video ends with a wide shot of the restaurant's red and white "Rom'antica Pizza" sign above the entrance.
